Windows App

ShareKM

A tiny Windows tray app that lets one keyboard and mouse control two PCs on the same network, with clipboard text shared both ways. One hotkey switches which PC you are on. It finds the other PC by itself, pairs with a passphrase and encrypts everything it sends (AES-256-GCM), and can optionally run as administrator to control elevated windows. A single self-contained exe: no install, no account, no PowerToys. Free for non-commercial use, with the source on GitHub.

Features

  • One hotkey to switch control between your PCs (rebindable with a Record button)
  • Finds other PCs running ShareKM on the network automatically
  • Passphrase pairing with AES-256-GCM encryption on the link
  • Clipboard text shared in both directions
  • Adjustable mouse update rate (60-1000 Hz)
  • Optional administrator mode to control elevated windows
  • Windows 11 style settings window, follows light and dark mode
  • Single self-contained exe, starts with Windows

Technologies

C# .NET WinForms Win32 hooks AES-GCM
